checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: protocol-gated study arms for RCT with per-session arm logging and consent

impact_assessment.why: Investigational-device RCT needs arm assignment, exposure logging and consent in-app; randomisation stays with the protocol, the app records and discloses
impact_assessment.benefits: trial can test engagement variants with full traceability while the default product stays unchanged and safety monitoring covers all arms
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive optional arm field and study key; dependency: none new; concurrency: single-writer localStorage; state: study enrollment coexists with history/export
impact_assessment.mitigation: arm-gated UI only, never default; consent required to enroll; withdraw keeps data; AE/heavy-use monitoring active in every arm

[1/3] Plan: incentive-design update (deposit contracts, RPE surprise) with arm-dependent schedules and finisher bonus

impact_assessment.why: Deposit contracts beat lotteries and persist after removal (36367428); unexpected rewards drive consolidation via RPE; the engagement arm should differ by schedule, not just reminders
impact_assessment.benefits: trial tests a real incentive gradient (schedule volatility + attendance-contingent gain) with full logging
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive schedule field and bonus; dependency: none new; concurrency: single-writer; state: schedule lives in motivation state, bonus recorded
impact_assessment.mitigation: optional params keep existing call sites green; default schedule unchanged; copy stays gain-framed per deposit-RCT warning; claim lint gates new strings

[1/3] Plan: weekly session goal with goal-gradient framing from 3 new goal-setting records

impact_assessment.why: Specific goals move behaviour g=1.11 (38560998); daily+weekly beats weekly-only (26445201); implementation intentions need reinforcement (30427874); goal proximity accelerates effort
impact_assessment.benefits: explicit weekly target + proximity nudge + met-goal recognition close the intention-behaviour gap the review identifies
impact_assessment.risks: contract: one additive settings field; dependency: none new; concurrency: single-writer; state: weekly goal coexists with difficulty/length
impact_assessment.mitigation: validated 1-7 range with default 3; display-only progress derived from history; copy stays gain-framed and lint-checked

[1/3] Plan: ground practice in testing-effect and spacing evidence; count goal in days

impact_assessment.why: Rowland 2014 (g=0.50 testing>restudy) and Cepeda 2006 (spaced beats massed at every interval) show the current session-counted goal lets users cram; days are the spacing-aligned unit
impact_assessment.benefits: goal, calendar and streak align on one unit; retrieval-practice core loop becomes an explicit cited claim
impact_assessment.risks: contract: display semantics change sessions to days; dependency: none new; concurrency: n/a; state: same numeric setting, new meaning
impact_assessment.mitigation: week.days already instrumented; same adjustable 1-7 range; tests pin the new copy; claim lint gates new strings

[1/3] Plan: habit evidence plus slip-tolerant recovery nudge

impact_assessment.why: Habit strength improves with intervention (SMD 0.69, 39685110) but takes ~2 months; single misses do not reset formation (Lally 2009); habit correlates with frequency at r=0.46 (21626256). The app punishes nothing but also says nothing after a slip
impact_assessment.benefits: a missed day gets a warm, evidence-true response instead of silence; habit horizon (~2 months) sets honest expectations
impact_assessment.risks: contract: display-only derivation from history; dependency: none new; concurrency: n/a; state: no new keys
impact_assessment.mitigation: pure date logic over stored sessions; copy gain-framed and lint-checked; no streak penalty anywhere
